scope: Independent static compiler/test review and read-only verification of the final raw-array specialization, retained measurements, qualification, documentation, charts and archives.

resolved_findings.issue: Original catalog upstream bench.goose bytes were absent from the first archive inspected.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final inputs archive retains all 41 original catalog upstream files; their recorded SHA-256 values match.

checks.compiler: Closed-module proof rejects explicit exports and reachable nonintrinsic extern imports after reachability/intrinsic classification. Type walk covers globals, captures, declarations, nested fields and natural call/inline results, rejecting unknown, prefixed and runtime-capacity forms. Nonzero mode constructors are checked centrally; remaining mode writes initialize zero or copy existing descriptors. Raw validation elides checks previously conditional on nonzero modes; varint elements remain rejected.
checks.tests: Existing exported-memory forged/unknown-mode tests remain intact. Expanded eight-method test covers actual import-callback forging of stale base/count and eligible sqrt intrinsics at O0/O2, with 26 direct configurations, 24 native golden checks, 52 Wasm executions and 22 helper-presence pairs. Its current source hash matches the retained final rerun.
checks.compiler_identities: Baseline 82b14bd7e795864606042853b13994e0fa8e6bddb22f02f9eef19d87849043e8, preliminary 68198faf79036626efccdb0cadc67dc2da9dfc1b6b5c4b256e027649b2f210f1 and final 78178c171d7ed846ac20aec7b54f5e2e80ffb5a73bbf3551c44b73b27b373624 remain distinct; all 29 header hashes per compiler match retained snapshots. Current compiler bytes match final identity, and compiler-changes.patch matches the reviewed diff.

paired_probes.notes: Recomputed sample indexing, baseline/candidate medians and paired ratios; checked timing boundaries and artifact hashes.

checks.module_identity: All ten final modules match preliminary paired, final paired and example-build artifacts. Eight differ from baseline; Squares and Tour are identical. Total bytes match 412112 before and 275693 after.

qualification.coverage: Exact three-mode coverage, all comparison flags true, zero failures, and equal before/after replay input and AOT pins.

charts.visual_inspection: Root recorded visual inspection of all nine charts; this reviewer independently checked SVG data labels and archive byte preservation, without rendering.

checks.machine_code: Final retained disassemblies and AOT hashes agree with machine-code.json; Life neighbours has two IDIV sites and Sudoku count_bits has no POPCNT. Static sites are not dynamic cost attribution.
checks.documentation: README, benchmark methods and audit distinguish paired entry probes, separate ordinary process cohorts, excluded AOT preparation, unchanged controls/kernels, preliminary proof boundary and default-AOT replay limits. Reported values and chart pointers agree with retained data.

limitations: No compiler builds, guest executions, benchmarks or chart rendering were performed by this reviewer; execution results were checked through retained data and logs.

The closed-module proof assumes the documented single _start invocation and goose output/abort/exit import semantics. General external re-entry and nonintrinsic callbacks retain dynamic mode dispatch.
Preliminary compiler lacked the export/import exclusion. Its ten benchmark modules are byte-identical to final modules; final correctness qualification applies to the guarded final compiler.

Entry measurements include initialization, callbacks and possible lazy JIT. Separate process cohorts are not paired speedup evidence. Unchanged Tour and small timing cells show variability; no clear Life Wasmtime gain or unchanged LangArena kernel gain is established.
Default precompiled mode received twenty example-artifact checks and ten WAT test methods across four modes, not the full replay.

Compiler/engine/tool executables, Wasmtime library, SDK binary archive and full differential/replay guest binaries are intentionally omitted. Recorded identities, retained source/SDK headers, benchmark guests, logs and reports preserve the stated evidence scope.
SHA256.json is generated after this review and is excluded from reviewed-file fingerprints. Visual layout acceptance relies on the separately recorded root review.
